about: Shared smart progression contract. Edit this file, then run `node scripts/sync_progression_fixtures.cjs` to copy it into both apps. Android ProgressionFixturesTest and iOS ProgressionFixtureTests execute every case. Loads are written in `unit` (or a log's `loadUnit`) and converted with each app's canonical kilogram conversion. Expected targets use the case `unit` unless `targetUnit` says otherwise. `applied` is the exact input text Apply Target (or Use lighter week) writes; Apply must also store the target's canonical kilograms unchanged, leave reps empty and show the target reps as their placeholder. A case `context` is the active workout day and current time, as the session screen passes them; records default to programId and workoutId `fixture`, and `snapshot` lists the prescription saved with a record. `steps` sets the dumbbell/machine load-step settings in the case unit (defaults: 2 kg / 5 kg, 5 lb / 10 lb); `platesKg` sets the available plates (default includes 1.25 kg). A log's `effort` is easy, right or hard. `variation` is the suggested exercise ID; `rationaleArgs` lists arguments that must match.
